payload.comment: Comparison stage is internally consistent and arithmetically correct. Verification: (1) accuracy_delta 0.896379 − 0.821309 = 0.075070 ✓; (2) baseline_met_or_exceeded = true is correct since 0.896379 > 0.821309; (3) common_split_fingerprint matches baseline_report.split_fingerprint (9afc9ed3…c7505) ✓; (4) common_seed 42 matches both reports ✓; (5) agentic_accuracy matches evaluation_report.accuracy ✓; (6) baseline_accuracy matches baseline_report.accuracy ✓; (7) primary_metric declared as accuracy, consistent with both source reports. No deterministic findings. The baseline is a deliberately minimal tiny_cnn (depth 2, hidden 16) serving as a fixed conventional control with the same 15-epoch cosine budget, which is a valid methodological choice. Minor observation: the baseline report lacks a 95 % CI on accuracy (the agentic evaluation report includes one), so the delta CI cannot be formally stated from the artifacts alone; however, with n = 7 180 and a 7.5 pp gap the result is unambiguously significant. All carried-forward warnings from prior stages (validation-to-test coverage gap, transformer config fields on ResNet-18, early-stopping patience mismatch, best_epoch = final epoch, class-imbalance ratio discrepancy, weak-class recall) remain valid context but do not affect the comparison-stage arithmetic or logic. Proceed to next stage.

Carried-forward: early_stopping_patience=3 in final config vs 5 in selected search trial; confirm intentional for 15-epoch cosine schedule
Carried-forward: rationale references prior resnet18 baseline 0.9908 not present in current search_report; record provenance
Carried-forward: best_epoch=15 (final epoch) with validation accuracy still improving; 15-epoch budget may be insufficient
Carried-forward: Class 7 recall 0.622 and Class 5 F1 0.713 are weakest; 246 class-0→class-5 and 63 class-7→class-2 misroutes warrant targeted error analysis
Carried-forward: test-set class-imbalance ratio (~3.9×) exceeds the 1.63× cited in rationale; confirm which split the figure refers to
Minor: baseline report lacks a 95 % CI on accuracy (agentic report includes one); delta CI not formally derivable from artifacts, though the 7.5 pp gap at n=7180 is unambiguously significant
